title: Zero-actor bind of an upper-bound grant leaves an active empty summoning effect
description: eshyra-ffoo.1: start_effect admits binding 0 linked actors for a maxCountPerCost grant (Pipes of the Sewers: charge wasted, per user spec) and records an active summoning effect with no actor links that the DM must end with end_effect. Consider whether such a bind should create the effect already ended (or a dedicated outcome) so no empty effect lingers. Not a pre-freeze blocker: the spec explicitly requires 'bind 0 OK'; the evidence test pins current behavior. Files: packages/core/src/state/activeEffects.ts (validateItemGrantBinding), packages/core/test/itemChargeDawnRecharge.test.ts.
notes:
Captain 2026-11-07: PRE-FREEZE (user bias against deferral; state-integrity smell). DECISION: a zero-actor bind of an upper-bound grant redeems the credit and then ends the new effect immediately through the same path as the last-owned-creature rule (closeActorLinkAtZeroHp -> finalizeEnd, reason source-removed), with detail no-creatures-answered and a note quoting 'If there aren't enough rats to form a swarm, the charge is wasted.' No empty active summoning effect may remain. Tests: bind 0 -> the effect is ended, the credit is redeemed (a second bind on it is refused), and auditActiveEffectIntegrity is clean; bind 2 is unchanged.
Captain 2026-11-07: integrated (ffoo 489d724c, 0dtg 36734512) after own review and verify (exit 0, 7481; pack exact). PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/731 (stacked on #727). Stays in_progress until merged.
